Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-04.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: Go dig your grave if you want a rest. Now it's time to fight!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; tab == 1

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-06.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: Who would bestow the title of Shillien Knight on someone so careless? Letting an assassin get so close! You couldn't beat a golem without my help. Galadrid would be upset.
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; tab == 1

links.text: "Are you trying to pick a fight?"

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-01.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: That wretch is aiming for you! Don't just stand there, fight!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-03.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: You're not strong enough to fight me, so stand back. Normally assassins don't run so easily. Don't worry, you'll get your turn.
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-05.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: Scram! This is my fight, not yours.
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; tab == 1

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-07.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: A blind girl falls in love with a silly wizard and flees, and what's more, there's a clumsy assassin and a Shillien Knight who doesn't know his mission! Who needs a comedy club!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; tab == 1

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-02.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: This isn't your fight! Stand back!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-08.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: Shame, shame. They call you an assassin? Hey you, commune with the tablet already!

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-010.ht.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: This is the Stone of Commune you came all this way for. I'll give you a free tip. Don't rely on Galadrid too much, but don't fear him either. A Shillien Knight should know what to do. Maybe we'll meet again. Such a baby.

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-011.ht.text: Shikken Gloomdrake: Nothing is worse than forgetting your special purpose. Take the Stone of Commune, you've come this far for it.

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/4-09.htm.text: Shiken Gloomdrake: What do you think the Stone of Commune is for? The Tablet of Vision that's right under your nose! Get it?
